errorCodes.meaning: The request is not yet approved. Returned after the service has held the call for up to 25 s. `details.state` gives the state, and `details.matchNumber` the number to show once the request is claimed. The starter retries with a freshly signed document.
The request was declined or cancelled and will not be approved. `details.state` says which.
The redeem is not signed by the request's starter key.
The request has expired or was already consumed.
Another poll is already open for this request, or the starter's network has hit the poll cap. `details.retryAfter` MAY give seconds until a retry.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

RequestId.description: The service-generated handle of one request: 16 to 32 bytes from a cryptographically secure random source, written as unpadded base64url (22 to 43 characters; 16 bytes, 22 characters, is RECOMMENDED). It is also the nonce of the exchange, so the family needs no separate challenge, and it is the `_id` of the trigger link (VTI-LNK-033). Compared as a string. It confers no authority on its holder.
RequestId.title: RequestId

Response.description: For `login`: who is now signed in, for the starter's "Continue as …?" confirmation. Never tokens: over HTTPS the session itself is delivered as HttpOnly cookies.

amr.description: Authentication Methods References (RFC 8176) for the session. For this family: `["did", "oob", "uv"]`.

displayName.description: A name for the signed-in identity, for the confirmation step. Untrusted wherever rendered.

sessionEndsAt.description: When the session ends, as an RFC 3339 date-time: the earlier of the grant's `sessionEndsAt` and the service's session limit.

subject.description: The approving DID — the grant's issuer — now the session's subject.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Redeem — response payload

schema.description: The starter turns an approved out-of-band request into the outcome its purpose defines — for `login`, a session bound to the starter key. Issued and signed by the starter key; held as a long poll until the request is approved. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
